items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Recharts container that declares --series-1..6 from the project's own chart tokens, so charts follow a client palette instead of baking colours in. Composes Recharts chart types rather than hiding them.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>

items.name: carousel-rail
items.title: Carousel rail
items.description: Embla drag rail with controls and progress dots painted from semantic tokens. Embla renders nothing itself, which is why the rail can be retokened without touching the library.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>

items.name: reveal
items.title: Reveal
items.description: The single entrance animation. Reads --ui-dur-med and --ui-ease from the theme so motion is a brand property, and collapses to a near-instant fade under prefers-reduced-motion.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>

items.name: contact-form
items.title: Contact form
items.description: Per-field validation before the round trip, with one zod schema usable unchanged inside a server action. Submission is the caller's, because where a lead goes is a per-client decision.
items.author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
